const std = @import("std");

pub fn collectEvens(allocator: std.mem.Allocator, xs: []const i32) ![]i32 {
    var evens: std.ArrayList(i32) = .empty;
    errdefer evens.deinit(allocator);

    for (xs) |x| {
        if (@rem(x, 2) == 0) {
            try evens.append(allocator, x);
        }
    }

    return evens.toOwnedSlice(allocator);
}

const std = @import("std");

pub fn distinctCount(allocator: std.mem.Allocator, words: []const []const u8) !usize {
    var seen = std.StringHashMap(void).init(allocator);
    defer seen.deinit();

    for (words) |word| {
        try seen.put(word, {});
    }

    return seen.count();
}
